The '''Fornaak Falls Cavern''' was located in the [[Kaamos Territory]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] near the [[Juran Pass]] coming from the [[Kaamos Territory]]. Around [[3642 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Fellil]] and a number of [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] inside this cave by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]-affiliated individuals.
